name: Text Block
summary: Narrative block for pitchbook pages: prose with a safe markdown subset, numbered key takeaways, callout box, serif pull quote or big-number stats with count-up — optionally filled live from a dataset via {{field|format}} placeholders.
summary_zh: 页面叙事模块：安全 Markdown 子集正文、编号要点卡片、强调框、衬线体引言、大数字统计（数字滚动），可用 {{字段|格式}} 占位符从数据集实时取数。
description_zh: 用于执行摘要、章节要点、关键结论和引言等纯文字内容，通过 variant 切换五种版式：prose（正文，支持 **粗体**、*斜体*、“- ” 列表、“1. ” 编号列表与换行，其余内容一律转义）、takeaways（大号衬线编号的要点卡片）、callout（左侧色条强调框）、quote（衬线体引言 + 署名）、stats（大数字 + 说明，进入视口时数字滚动）。不需要数据即可使用；绑定数据集后，文本中的 {{字段}}、{{字段|0.0x}}、{{median(字段)|0.0x}}（对全部筛选后行聚合）、{{@参数|0.0%}} 会用 options.row 指定的行（行号或表达式，如 "is_target"）实时填充，并随全局筛选和参数联动更新。适合把数字结论直接写进叙述，保证正文与图表口径一致。
best_for: Executive summary and section key takeaways
Callouts next to a chart (key consideration, risk, next step)
Headline stats strip with live numbers from the model
Narrative sentences that must stay in sync with the data (placeholders)
avoid_when: More than ~6 takeaways or stats on one page (split the page)
Untrusted HTML — options.html is meant for report authors only

title.desc: Takeaway title per row — used only when options.items is empty and a dataset is bound

format.desc: Per-row format code for the stats value (falls back to the value field format)

note.desc: Small secondary line under a stat (e.g. comparison period)

text.desc: Body text in the safe markdown subset (**bold**, *italic*, '- ' bullets, '1. ' numbered, line breaks, blank line = paragraph); used by prose, callout and quote. Supports {{placeholders}}

html.desc: Trusted author HTML instead of text (scripts, event handlers and javascript: URLs are stripped); placeholders are filled

items.desc: takeaways: [{title, text}]; stats: [{value | field | expr, format, label, note, tone}] — value may also be a '{{...}}' placeholder or literal text. When empty and a dataset is bound, one item per row via encode

row.desc: Row used for {{field}} placeholders: index into the (filtered) rows, or an RK.expr predicate such as "is_target" (first match)

kicker.desc: Callout small-caps label above the heading, e.g. 'Key consideration'

tone.desc: Callout rule colour token: accent | accent2 | accent3 | pos | neg | neutral (also per stats item)

columns.desc: prose: number of text columns (> 1); takeaways / stats: fixed grid columns (auto-fit when null)

layout.desc: takeaways: grid (cards side by side) | list (stacked rows, numeral on the left — for narrow blocks)

lead.desc: prose: set the first paragraph as a larger serif lead-in

countUp.desc: stats: count numbers up on reveal and animate from old to new values on filter changes

tools.desc: Show the block toolbar (off by default for narrative blocks)

interactions: Count-up of stats on reveal; animated old-to-new values when filters or parameters change
Placeholders update live with global filters, cross-filters and what-if parameters
Staggered entry of takeaway cards and stats (disabled for print / reduced motion)

options.title: Regulatory approvals set the critical path to closing
options.text:
Antitrust filings in **four jurisdictions** and an FDI review in Germany are expected to take *12–14 weeks* from signing.
- Pre-notification talks to start in parallel with due diligence
- Hell-or-high-water covenant to be tested with bidders
We have built a business that compounds through the cycle. The next chapter needs a partner with the balance sheet to accelerate it.
